items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Perry Bradford in the context of Bill's collaborations, but the interviewee (Budd Johnson) does not mention Perry Bradford or describe any personal interaction with him.

ctx.x: And which Bill is going to tell you a little bit about a little later on.

Yeah, Bill has been so instrumental in collaborating on so many other beautiful things with me, with your brother Keg Johnson, with Ennie before his demise, with Perry Bradford and Ennie Blake, and we're going to have to get together on some of these things. Bill has always been a double check for us.
